harness: e2e/perf-grass.mjs unchanged: GRASS_ARMS=normal GRASS_RADIUS=10 GRASS_DISTANCES=near,medium,far PERF_EXCLUSIVE=1; GRASS_ROUNDS=3 per camera, plus GRASS_ROUNDS=2 extra on the play camera (rows with round 3 and 4, source_file play-extra.json)
notes: exclusivity.after process lists stripped from rows; the rest of each row is as the harness wrote it
paired deltas are arm minus near within one round; a round counts only when both rows are valid
real = every paired delta has one sign and the median is larger than their spread (max - min)
